messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — during the deltas-13b canary we hit repeated memory-fragmentation spikes when using windowed batching. High tail latency + occasional OOMs after sustained traffic. Posting traces and current config, anyone seen this pattern before? cc @alisa @raja :eyes:

alisa: yep, saw similar on another model last month. high seq-length variance + dynamic windowing tends to fragment arenas. OOMs usually happen when temp buffers + KV caches align.

maria: can you paste the logs and the batching config?

jamie: logs and config below. note we switched to int4 quant in the canary build which may have changed per-layer workspace needs.

```yaml
model: deltas-13b
batching:
  strategy: windowed
  window_ms: 8
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  min_batch_size: 2
fallback_policy: small-batch
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
  kv_prefetch: true
  kv_trim_threshold: 0.6
```

logs:
```
[2025-11-03T14:12:07Z] WARN serve: arena fragmentation > 0.78, trying purge
[2025-11-03T14:12:08Z] ERROR inference: Alloc failed when growing KV cache: cannot allocate 131072 bytes
[2025-11-03T14:12:08Z] ERROR runtime: OOM at step 4823, falling back to compact-variant
```

jamie: stack shows allocator failing inside layer workspace grow.

raja: couple quick ideas —
- drop window_ms to 4 or 2 for this model, that reduces concurrent big batches.
- set a stricter default max_new_tokens = 128 (matches most prod prompts) so per-request allocs are smaller.
- enable background arena release (jemalloc tunables) or call `arena.purge_interval_ms=200` in the runtime.
- add a small-batch fast-path so tiny seqs don't wait and coalesce into huge windows.

command to push quick change (canary):
```bash
rwctl model update deltas-13b --set defaults.max_new_tokens=128 --set batching.window_ms=4 --env canary
```

alisa: also note the int4 build we used created an extra per-layer temporary buffer for attention fusions. that increases peak by ~120MB on deltas-13b compared to int8. if you want to keep int4, set `workspace_mb=64` instead of 128 for the layer fusion or toggle `fusion.enabled=false` for canary.

maria: we should add a repro loadtest that mixes 32/512/2048 seqs to surface frag. i'll add a scenario to perf-harness and run with `--repeat 10k` to see tail behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy started for deltas-13b canary (canary id: c-20251103-09) — will route 2% traffic for 15m.

jamie: thanks. i'll kick the rwctl change and start the mixed-length loadtest. if we still see OOMs, plan B is immediate rollback to deltas-13b-compact (fallback variant) and disable windowed batching. :thumbsup:

raja: rollback commands if needed:
```bash
rwctl rollout rollback c-20251103-09
rwctl model set-variant deltas-13b --active deltas-13b-compact
```

jamie: updating the canary now. will report perf graphs and memory heatmap in ~45m.
